# Neominds

> AI-Enabled Product Engineering & Full-Spectrum Software Development

## Overview
Neominds is an elite corporate software engineering firm delivering custom software, autonomous AI agent pipelines, cloud microservices, and regulated enterprise applications.

## Core Capabilities
- **Design Thinking**: User-centric product discovery, interaction logic, and design systems.
- **Custom Software Development**: Resilient cloud-native microservices, scalable distributed architectures.
- **AI & Machine Learning**: Cognitive workflows, LLM orchestration, agentic pipelines, vector retrieval.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Multi-cloud orchestration, Kubernetes, automated GitOps CI/CD pipelines.
- **Mobile Development**: High-performance native iOS, Android, and Flutter applications.
- **Legacy Modernization**: Microservices strangler-fig migration without business disruption.
- **Quality Assurance**: Automated regression testing, performance benchmarking, chaos engineering.
